goal: Add token-metadata discovery for unregistered AO tokens, so tokens beyond the hardcoded HyperBEAM-verified registry can be identified and denominated correctly, using the gateway's GraphQL endpoint against process-spawn tags -- no dryrun/CU round-trip needed, and the result is cacheable indefinitely since spawn tags are immutable.
outcome: packages/core/src/ao/balance.ts and packages/core/src/pricing/token-sources.ts gain a metadata-lookup path that queries transactions(ids: [processId]) { tags } on the gateway's GraphQL endpoint and extracts denomination, ticker, name, description, logo, and total-supply directly from the process-spawn tags -- verified working against process hmW7EXCHRzfC6YAE8FKInptdS8-6BOl3fxjZfxmAOpY ("Legacy wUSDC"). This is additive to the existing hardcoded-registry, HyperBEAM-only balance path (GLEAM-WALLET decision, unchanged) -- it does not replace or weaken that decision, it only adds identification for tokens not yet in the registry.

requirements.statement: Token metadata is resolved from process-spawn GraphQL tags only -- no dryrun/CU round-trip is introduced. The existing HyperBEAM ~process@1.0 compute-only balance path and hardcoded-registry decision are unchanged.
Metadata lookup results are cached indefinitely (spawn tags are immutable) -- no TTL-based invalidation is needed or added.
core package logic (ao/balance.ts, pricing/token-sources.ts) has zero chrome.*/window/document dependency (GLEAM-WALLET-RULE-1, unchanged).
Querying metadata for process hmW7EXCHRzfC6YAE8FKInptdS8-6BOl3fxjZfxmAOpY resolves ticker, denomination, name, description, logo, and total-supply from its spawn tags.
pnpm vitest run arweave ao pricing activity send receive passes; pnpm tsc -p packages/core --noEmit passes.
